Aggregate all registered slots: conflict if any is conflicting; otherwise true if any is true; otherwise false only if every slot is false; else unknown. A TAF is not a neighbor observation. Output JSON strings for truth values, never booleans. Return exactly the requested JSON object, with no prose or markdown. The output must have exactly fact_truth.
